question: Should Codex-specific progress identification become a permanent public plugin-SDK contract, or should this use a generic progress-intent API?
rationale: Repository SDK policy favors generic multi-consumer seams, while this branch exposes Codex-named symbols for a single producer-to-Slack path; only an owner can authorize that long-term external contract.

options.title: Use generic progress intent
options.body: Replace the Codex-named exports with a closed generic progress contract shared by current and future producers.

options.title: Approve Codex-specific exports
options.body: Accept the new constant and predicate as supported third-party plugin API and maintain their compatibility.

recommendation.title: Use generic progress intent
recommendation.body: Replace the Codex-named exports with a closed generic progress contract shared by current and future producers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person to the SDK, Codex projection, and Slack dispatch boundaries involved in the decision.
